Muddy boots, happy kids, calm parents.

A small daycare in Hyde Park for children from 6 months to 5 years. Home-cooked lunches, a big garden and a photo diary so you never miss a moment.

Book a visitSee fees
Open 7:30am to 6pmRatios better than requiredRated OutstandingFree hours accepted

A day at Little Acorns

Children like knowing what comes next. Here's our usual routine. The yellow step is what we're doing right now.

    Age groups and fees

    Each room has its own team, so your child sees the same friendly faces every day.

    staff to children
    full day

      Safe, every single day

      The things we never skip, so you can go to work without worrying.

      Checked staff

      Every adult has an enhanced background check and paediatric first aid training.

      Secure doors

      Keypad entry, and children only go home with adults on your list, with a password.

      Allergy aware

      Nut-free kitchen, colour-coded plates and a written plan for every allergy.

      Photo diary

      See naps, meals and nappy changes on our parent app, plus photos through the day.

      Sleep checks

      Babies are checked every 10 minutes while they nap, and we write it down.

      Inspected

      Rated Outstanding at our last inspection. Read the full report at reception.

      Come and visit

      Visits take about 40 minutes. Bring your little one, they'll probably want to stay.

      "My son cried for two days, then started running in without saying goodbye. That's how I knew."

      Parent of a toddler

      Little Acorns, 9 Chestnut Row, Hyde Park, Leeds. 0113 496 0355

# Kids Daycare

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/education/kids-daycare/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
